channel.title: MYRSS Daily Digest
channel.description: Ten curated world-affairs and wind-down articles, two per publication. Selection from the repository's latest seven-day archive and RSS feeds, prioritising the past 48 hours. Most summaries use publisher RSS metadata; two Reuters articles were checked against original reporting. Source feeds were last refreshed around 07:00 UTC on 20 November 2026, so later stories may be absent.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Drie doden bij Russische raketaanvallen op Kyiv, drie bruggen geraakt
item.description: de Volkskrant reports three deaths and damage to three bridges following Russian missile strikes on Kyiv. Headline-only account; the full article was not accessed.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Bondgenoten van Oekraïne zetten zich in Berlijn af tegen topontmoeting Xi, Trump en Poetin
item.description: According to de Volkskrant's headline, Ukraine's allies meeting in Berlin distanced themselves from the Xi-Trump-Putin summit. Headline-only account.

item.title: New York Times | Myanmar Committed Genocide Against the Rohingya, Top Global Court Finds
item.description: The New York Times RSS summary reports that the International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya, describing this as the court's first such ruling against a state. Based on RSS metadata.

item.title: New York Times | Easing Back From Brexit: What to Expect at U.K. Summit With E.U.
item.description: The New York Times previews a UK-EU summit and a gradual rapprochement a decade after the Brexit referendum, amid global pressure. Based on RSS metadata.

item.title: Follow the Money | Hoe land­bouw­kennis uit Wageningen kan bijdragen aan de onderdrukking van Oeigoeren
item.description: FTM's RSS summary reports that Dutch agricultural researchers in Xinjiang work with researchers from the XPCC, a paramilitary organisation implicated in land appropriation and repression of Uyghurs and other minorities. Publisher's investigation, not independently verified here.

item.title: Follow the Money | Vijf onthullingen uit de gelekte Deutsche Bank-documenten
item.description: FTM presents five findings from a multinational investigation by more than 200 journalists across 55 other outlets into 15 million leaked Deutsche Bank documents. Based on the publisher's RSS summary.

item.title: Reuters | Taiwan tells Meta thousands of China-linked accounts seek to influence elections
item.description: Reuters reports Taiwanese officials flagged nearly 2,700 suspected China-linked Threads accounts to Meta before local elections. Meta said it removed flagged low-quality accounts but said none had posted election-related content. Based on Reuters original reporting.

item.title: Reuters | US Senate passes bipartisan bill to speed energy and infrastructure projects
item.description: Reuters reports the US Senate passed a permitting reform bill 62-33, sending it to the House. The measure would accelerate project reviews and require large AI data centres to pay more of related grid upgrade costs; opponents warn of weakened environmental and tribal protections. Based on Reuters original reporting.

item.title: The New Yorker | We Played the New Grand Theft Auto
item.description: Wind-down: Julian Lucas reviews the new Grand Theft Auto in The New Yorker's daily newsletter. Based on the RSS summary.

item.title: The New Yorker | Why the Courtroom Keeps Us Watching
item.description: Wind-down: The New Yorker critics discuss the enduring appeal of courtroom dramas, including the tech-focused legal series Cupertino. Based on the RSS summary.
